rules.Cloud: highest accuracy; latency/size are not binding (fast CPU/GPU, lots of memory)
rules.Edge: lowest p95 latency with accuracy drop <= 1.0 pp
rules.Mobile: int8 only, smallest size then p95, drop <= 1.5 pp
rules.TinyML: full-integer int8 only (no FPU/PyTorch on MCU), smallest size, drop <= 2.0 pp
